title: Repository retention statement
purpose: Record or clear the repository’s own electronic record-retention statement with a reason.
summary: Record, change or clear the repository's own record-retention statement, with a reason.

tasks.title: Change the retention statement
steps: Edit [[Record retention statement]], or clear it to show Not recorded.

tasks.title: Read earlier statements
steps: The reason and the statement before and after each change are in the audit history, not in [[History]].

good_to_know: The statement is a record of your repository's policy. It does not delete anything automatically.
If someone else saved first, you are asked to reload and review their statement.
The name and timezone are read only here.
A save that leaves the statement unchanged is refused.

sections.title: Access and fields
paragraphs: Requires an active staff superuser with the admin role.

items.label: Timezone
items.description: Read-only recorded setup timezone. Dates are parsed and shown using deployment TIME_ZONE, not an editable override here.

items.label: Record retention statement
items.description: Optional maximum 8000-character statement; whitespace is trimmed. Blank clears it to Not recorded. It configures no automatic electronic deletion or physical specimen disposal schedule.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required nonblank explanation, maximum 2000 characters; retained with actor and before/after evidence.

items.label: Revision check
items.description: Hidden expected revision, prefilled from the opened record. The current record is locked and rechecked; a stale save requires reloading and reviewing the new statement.

sections.title: Saving rules
paragraphs: The statement must actually change after trimming. Statement, incremented revision and attributed retention audit event commit together. Validation failures keep the form open. Repository name and timezone cannot be edited here, and repository creation and deletion are unavailable. Physical specimen retention is a separate matter.

items.label: Save
items.description: Saves a valid changed statement and returns to the repository list.

items.label: Save and continue editing
items.description: Saves and reopens the repository form with its new revision.

items.label: History
items.description: Opens the separate Django administration log; the full retention reason and before/after statement are in the audit event.

items.label: Save and add another / Delete
items.description: Not offered: adding and deleting repositories are disabled.

items.label: Home / Core / Repositories / View site
items.description: Breadcrumbs return through maintenance; View site returns to the operational application.
